category: seedbox host (brand retired into Hosting by Design)

free_tier.stated: None. The seedbox.io domain no longer serves a seedbox product: every request lands on hostingby.design, whose cheapest entry is 'App hosting €6.59 Starting price'.
free_tier.notes: seedbox.io and www.seedbox.io both resolve to hostingby.design with a wp-json Link header naming that host

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: no seedbox product is offered at this domain any more

retention.stated: not applicable: no storage product is sold under this name

egress.terms: The successor publishes its own allowances: application hosting at EUR 10.95 includes '4TB' capacity and '10TB' outgoing data; the EUR 6.59 entry does not state an allowance on the page read.

interface_detail: the successor sells 'Application hosting' with 'SSH Access Included'; no torrent panel is described.
tooling: not applicable: the seedbox product and its panel are gone from this brand
chaining: do not plan around this name. The successor's app-hosting product is a generic VPS-shaped service and would have to be evaluated as compute, not as a seedbox.
limits_note: no limits apply because no seedbox is sold here; the successor's app-hosting tiers state 4 TB capacity and 10 TB outgoing on the EUR 10.95 plan.
binding_note: A dead brand has no constraint to fail: nothing is sold at this domain, so the record carries no binding limit by design rather than by omission.

identity_cost.detail: the successor requires an account and a card for hosting; there is no free tier.

reliability_note: a brand that was widely recommended as a cheap seedbox now redirects to a hosting consolidator ('Hostingby.design is a new consolidation of multiple brands under the HNielsen Technologies umbrella'), which is why any older guide naming seedbox.io is stale.
confidence_note: the redirect was observed twice today (apex and www) with the successor's own page returned as final_url. A historical price for seedbox.io itself was not recoverable and is not recorded.

evidence.proved: final_url is https://hostingby.design/ and the response Link header names hostingby.design/wp-json
'App hosting €6.59 Starting price', 'VPS Hosting €5.00', the EUR 10.95 application plan with 'Capacity 4TB' and 'Outgoing data 10TB', and the consolidation notice

notes: A dead end recorded so the next session does not spend a wave looking for seedbox.io's plans. The distinction that matters: what survives is a rented app-hosting box, not a torrent-to-cloud service and not a seedbox panel.
